title: Filesystem audit scanning traverses virtual environment and dependency directories
summary: Add .venv, node_modules, and third-party dependency exclusion paths to repository audit collector
why_relevant: Reduces audit execution duration (currently ~130s) and eliminates false metrics from vendored dependencies

investigation.why_hq_is_looking_at_this: The repository audit collector currently traverses virtual environment and dependency directories such as core/infrastructure/vm-processing/.venv, resulting in extended execution times (~130s) and false metrics from vendored code.
potential_benefits: Reduces audit execution duration from its current ~130s baseline
Eliminates false observability metrics generated by scanning vendored third-party dependencies
risks: Potential risk of inadvertently excluding relevant non-vendored repository files if path matching rules are misconfigured
Automation eligibility is currently flagged as needing more evidence
alternatives: Leave audit collector scanning unchanged and continue filtering false metrics post-collection
Manually specify an explicit inclusion allowlist of directories rather than exclusion paths
investigation.recommendation_rationale: The candidate has strong fit, low risk, and concrete benefits in reducing execution duration and metric noise. Although policy rationale noted automation eligibility needs more evidence, adding exclusion paths (.venv, node_modules) addresses a clear reliability and observability gap.

policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.95; Risk: low; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Changes to running services require verification
